message:
ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz && \
  gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
      -I.. -I../include -I. \
      -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION \
      /tmp/driver.c xml.c fuzz.c \
      -L../.libs -lxml2 -lz -llzma -lm -lpthread \
      -Wl,-rpath,/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/.libs \
      -o /tmp/driver 2>&1 | tail -10
(2) echo "build exit=$?"; ls -la /tmp/driver 2>/dev/null
